name: flutter-forge
description: Flutter engineering agent: user story + Figma + Postman/OpenAPI → Clean Architecture feature (BLoC, Riverpod or Provider) with unit, widget and Patrol tests, followed by a code audit and an OWASP MASVS security review. A separate forge-health skill writes a whole-repo health baseline with a prioritized backlog, and forge-metrics reports what each run cost. Adapts to any project through a .flutter-forge/ profile.
